summary: Loose shared infrastructure beneath the relation API: typed relation errors, native materialization (ExecutionForm, MaterializationPurpose, MaterializationScope, materialize_native), owned-copy lifecycle with owner-thread Ibis table cleanup, logical snapshots for structured carriers, structured lineage rules, join output layout, projection/aggregate name normalization, and fingerprint accumulation. No public re-exports; public collection and egress live on Relation.
key_classes: IncompleteSchemaError, CompileRequiresExecutionError, UnresolvedExecutionLocationError, ConflictingExecutionTargetError, UnsupportedRelationTransportError, LogicalTerminalRequired — typed relation errors (errors.py)
NativeExecutionValue / MaterializationScope — native value envelope and scoped lifetime (materialization.py)
OwnedCopy — independent native value with release hook (owned_copy.py)
LogicalTerminalSnapshot / ResolvedLogicalSnapshot — physical snapshot plus structured resolution (logical_snapshot.py)
JoinLayout — single naming rule for keyed join output (join_layout.py)
key_functions: materialize_native(...) — preserve backend identity when forcing eager execution
owned_copy(native) / owned_ibis_table / owned_arrow_table — independent copies with committed cleanup
join_layout(...) / layout_for_node(node, left, right) — canonical join output names incl. suffix collisions and coalesce
normalize_projection(expressions, *, operation) — encode proven names as aliases
normalize_aggregate(keys, measures) — shared aggregate naming boundary
consume_native_batches(...) — bounded scoped batch ingestion for fingerprint
